name: Madanapalle

queries.query: Madanapalle Andhra Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha cadastral-mapping portal, the Government of India DILRMP village-level map-digitization record for Madanapalle tehsil, and the APSAC Andhra Pradesh cadastral-maps portal. DILRMP lists Madanapalle (R) (Part) and other Madanapalle-tehsil villages with digitized, georeferenced cadastral maps linked to ROR and Bhu-Naksha; no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: మదనపల్లె ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ అధికారిక భూ రికార్డులు కాడస్ట్రల్ మ్యాప్ పార్సెల్
queries.result: Telugu first-party discovery identified the official Andhra Pradesh Bhudhaar service and the Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha cadastral-mapping portal. The Bhudhaar page exposes Telugu land-information and mutation service labels, while Bhunaksha identifies the state Survey, Settlements and Land Records department; no public safe parcel-ID-plus-geometry response was available.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Andhra Pradesh, Department of Survey, Settlements and Land Records (Bhunaksha), with Department of Land Resources DILRMP status for Madanapalle tehsil
registryEvidence.locality: Madanapalle tehsil, Annamayya district, Andhra Pradesh; DILRMP record includes Madanapalle (R) (Part)
registryEvidence.scopeNote: A state cadastral-map custodian and a government map-digitization record explicitly naming Madanapalle tehsil are evidenced. This establishes a local cadastral source/procedure, but not a public anonymous parcel API response for the supplied point.

parcelDiscovery.source: Bhunaksha AP / APSAC cadastral-map portals; DILRMP Madanapalle tehsil status
parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. No safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was observed, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Web search/open inspection reached the official AP Bhunaksha page, redirected to /bhunakshalpm/28/index.jsp; page identifies Government of Andhra Pradesh Survey, Settlements and Land Records and cadastral mapping/georeferenced spatial data. Direct shell curl timed out after 30 seconds; no schema or parcel response was inferred.

HTTP/web page retrieved. Official DILRMP lists Annamayya district, Madanapalle tehsil, including Madanapalle (R) (Part): 1379 map sheets/FMBs, 1261 digitized; spatially verified, georeferenced, linked with ROR, simultaneously updated, and Bhu-Naksha used. This is coverage/status evidence, not parcel geometry.
Official Telugu AP land-information/mutation portal was discovered; web fetch returned 502, so no service schema or geometry was inferred.
Official APSAC portal retrieved; it lists an Andhra Pradesh Cadastral Maps application.
Cadastral Maps application route followed; page exposed only an iframe placeholder in the available inspection, with no bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry response.

Official AP Industrial Infrastructure Corporation GIS viewer discovered; it advertises industrial land-parcel search, but it is not evidence of general Madanapalle cadastral coverage and no parcel request was made.

scopeLimits: The exact supplied WUP point [13.5589818965005, 78.50462679296] was preserved and not shifted.
DILRMP map-digitization status and the state portals establish source/custodian evidence only; they do not prove an exact-point parcel hit or citywide public parcel availability.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No TLS verification was disabled, no credentials or private tokens were used, and no CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass was attempted.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The supplied WUP point is a city point and was not used to force a parcel lookup or coordinate match.

The official Bhunaksha and APSAC application routes were reachable through web discovery, but current JavaScript/API configuration and a bounded anonymous parcel response were not exposed by the available fetches.
A direct shell request to Bhunaksha timed out and Bhudhaar returned 502; these are access outcomes, not evidence of cadastral absence.
